biotools.summary: Fish Acoustic Community Analysis is a tool that analyzes fish sounds recorded using static acoustic monitoring, inferring potential species based on sound features using Principal Component Analysis. This tool was used to characterize the underwater soundscape around a gas-production platform in the North Sea.
